reason: No candidate is named Barnard/Barend Jacobus. The owners are Willem Abraham (son of Barend), Andries and Paul Dirk, whose given names all contradict the genealogy.
Cornelis Hendricus does not match either Charl or Christoffel. These are clearly different given names, even though the district (Uitenhage) agrees.
The only owner, Godlieb Rudolph Opperman, has given names entirely different from Johannes Jacobus.
Pieter Willem Nel of George matches the first two given names of Pieter Willem Adriaan Nel, and the declared district (George) agrees. The other candidates have different given names.
Two Uitenhage owners are named Petrus Gerhardus Human. The '1' marking on C02 most plausibly distinguishes the elder of the two, which fits the genealogy's 'SR' (married 1820).

No owner is named Albertus Johannes. The nearest, Jan Albertus (Somerset), has the names in reversed order and a different district from Colesberg/Graaff-Reinet, which is too weak to be more likely than not.
Adriaan Bekker does not match Martinus Johannes or Johannes Hendrik. The given names clearly contradict.
None of the 21 Erasmus owners is named Willem Jacobus. Every candidate has clearly different first names, and C06 is a woman.
Petrus Lafras Moolman of Uitenhage (Gamtoosrivier) is an exact match for the genealogy's distinctive name and declared district.
No owner is named Gysbertus van Rooyen. All candidates have different given names and are in Uitenhage or Albany rather than Somerset.
